title: design
description: One row per observation unit (plant, pot, plot): its experimental factors. MIAPPE: observation unit + factor values. Treatment meaning, units, and dose-vs-category encoding come from the data owners, never from a guess.

unit_id.description: Stable observation-unit id used by every other view.

genotype.description: Genotype / accession / line label as given.

treatment.description: Treatment level as a categorical label (always a string, even for doses).

treatment_value.description: Numeric dose, only when the owners confirm it is a dose.

treatment_unit.description: Unit of treatment_value; null when unknown (then ask).

block.description: Blocking factor if the design has one.

position.description: Physical position (tray, slot, row, column) if recorded.

source_table.description: Raw table (relative to the bundle root) the row came from.

source_row_key.description: Key of the raw row, for tracing back.
